name: message-list
title: Message List
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Scroll container that follows new messages until the reader moves up, then offers a control to jump back to the latest one.

meta.descriptionEs: Contenedor que sigue los mensajes nuevos hasta que el lector sube, y entonces muestra un control para volver al final.

examples.title: Lista de mensajes
examples.description: Contenedor que sigue los mensajes nuevos hasta que el lector sube, y entonces muestra un control para volver al final.

api.name: jumpLabel
api.description: Label for the control shown after scrolling away. Default Jump to latest.

api.name: stickThreshold
api.description: Pixels from the bottom that still count as following. Default 72.

docs: Import MessageList from the installed UI file. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
